title: Drone strike near Jabalia wounds four as ceasefire toll reaches 1,610
detail: Per Anadolu Agency (Nov 8, 2026), five Palestinians were wounded across Gaza on Sunday: a drone fired a missile into a gathering at Bir al-Naaja, west of Jabalia, wounding four (one seriously), and a woman was shot in the back at the Qatari Camp in Khan Younis. Israeli vehicles fired toward southern Khan Younis and al-Shakoush west of Rafah, and artillery shelled areas east of Gaza City with no injuries. Gaza's Health Ministry puts the ceasefire-period toll at 1,610 killed and 5,819 wounded. Single-outlet report; not yet independently corroborated.

media.caption: Five Gazans wounded in continued Israeli attacks

title: Deadly sand cliff collapse hits displaced families in Gaza
detail: Per Al Jazeera (Nov 8, 2026), a sand cliff collapsed onto displaced families sheltering in Gaza, with deadly consequences. Only the headline was available at time of writing; casualty figures and exact location not yet confirmed. Single-outlet report.

media.caption: Deadly sand cliff collapses on displaced families in Gaza
